text: Three unit squares and two line segments connecting two pairs of vertices are shown. What is the area of $\triangle ABC$?
figure: Three unit squares form an L shape: two squares are stacked vertically on the left, and the third sits to the right of the upper-left square, so the top edge of the figure has length 2 and the left edge has length 2. A is the top-left corner of the upper-left square and B is its top-right corner (also the top-left corner of the right square), so AB = 1. One segment runs from A to the bottom-right corner of the right square. The other runs from B to the bottom-left corner of the lower-left square. The two segments cross at point C, which lies inside the upper-left square.
